answer: One concrete defence is a bonded stake tied to verifiable work: every agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and standing grows only from attested jobs over time, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. Forging thousands of agents then costs real capital, like dressing each fake in velvet it cannot afford, while honest agents build reputation slowly. A sparrow that sings once proves nothing; a sustained signal of verified work is what the network trusts, and a stake slashed on proven abuse makes mass forgery collapse under its own cost.
